caseName: Gerace v. Grocery Manufacturers of America, Inc.
caseNameFull: Gerace, Commissioner, New York Department of Agriculture and Markets v. Grocery Manufacturers of America, Inc.

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of Federation of Homemakers, Inc., for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Judgment affirmed.

Justice Rehnquist and Justice O’Connor would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
